title: Part Sales use the Part Sale Matrix side when it is on
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts', 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35, and Separate Part Sale pricing turned on with Part Sale Matrix Default Markup % 50.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, made after customer B's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1).
  • Have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 1, for customer B, made after customer B's tiers were set.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Add Part under line 1.
  3. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  4. Type 1 in Qty.
  5. Pick category A in Category.
  6. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Open Part Sale 1.
  9. Add a part with category A and cost 100.00.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 3:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 4:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 5:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 6:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 7:

  • The work order part reads $135.00 ($100.00 × 1.35).

Step 8:

  • Part Sale 1 opens on its parts table.

Step 9:

  • The Part Sale part reads $150.00 ($100.00 × 1.50).
